fields.summary_ko.0: NVDA is facing stock weakness pressure from a leadership vacuum due to unexpected resignation of founder Jensen Huang and controversy over alleged involvement of Chinese intelligence agencies.
fields.summary_ko.1: Considering precedents such as MSFT (+19% six months after CEO replacement), GOOGL (up six months after CEO replacement), and AMZN (-6% six months after CEO replacement), the direction of NVDA's stock price after management replacement remains uncertain.
